summary: Frontend-only test of the 2 new features on the preview URL: (A) 'Storico Riapribile' and (B) 'Export Confronto' (CSV/PDF via jsPDF + jspdf-autotable). Flow executed end-to-end with a synthetic Italian invoice PNG: upload -> model-gemini -> analyze-btn (analysis OK, 11 fields, 6 checks) -> compare-btn -> compare-panel (Gemini vs Claude Sonnet 5) -> compare-export-csv download 'confronto-modelli.csv' -> compare-export-pdf download 'confronto-modelli.pdf' (19 KB, valid) -> nav-history -> history-item expand -> history-reopen -> modal closed, #results shows reopened analysis (model-badge 'Claude Sonnet 5', 11 field rows), compare-btn correctly absent (count 0) -> Copilot ask on reopened analysis returned correct AI answer ('L'importo totale della fattura e 1830,00 EUR'). ZERO JS console errors and zero pageerrors captured (no 'autoTable is not a function' / import errors). Backend not tested (per request).

issues: Toast 'Esportato PDF' renders bottom-center and can visually overlap the after-analysis CTA card content (cosmetic only).

critical_code_review_comments: Results component is not re-keyed on reopen (App.js ~line 771): its local `msgs` chat state persists, so Copilot messages from a previous analysis would remain visible after clicking 'Riapri'. Suggest <Results key={analysisId} ...> to reset chat/local state. Low impact but user-visible.

The comparison run persists a second analysis document, so a single user analysis produces 2 entries in Storico (observed 2 history items after 1 upload + 1 compare). Verify this is intended; otherwise flag compare-generated analyses in the history list.
seed_data_creation: Anonymous session (3 free credits); 1 synthetic invoice image /tmp/fattura.png analyzed with Gemini + compare with Claude (2 credits consumed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (history reopen + compare CSV/PDF export) fully pass on the preview URL. Downloads verified via page.expect_download. Remaining optional check: Copilot chat-state reset after reopen when messages already exist (see code review comment).
